_comment: Public config only. Launch sites only (Phil 2026-11-17): Cape Canaveral LC-39A (LL2 pad 87), Starbase Texas OLP-1 (LL2 pad 188), Vandenberg SLC-4E (LL2 pad 16) and Starbase LA (planned, assumed location). Phil's 'Starbase Louisiana' has no Launch Library 2 pad or location match (searched 2026-11-17); per Phil (2026-11-17, 6:18 PM CT) it is added as 'Starbase LA (planned, assumed location)', one assumed point at 29.56 N, 92.43 W (Gulf coast south of Pecan Island, Vermilion Parish, LA) with the same 5/10 nmi rings, no LL2 id, src 'assumed (Phil, 2026-11-17), planned site'. LL2 coordinates are (ll.thespacedevs.com /2.3.0/pads/, the same source as A1 / PR 265) fetched 2026-11-17; src names the LL2 pad id. LL2 is not an official range source: spot-check against range charts before 12.0 ships. src/fetched stay in this config and are never published. rules.precipConnect* are ours (proxy), not 4010B numbers. Optional models: add "nbm" and/or "gefs" to models (off by default). minFreeGB is 1 for the GitHub-hosted runner (14 GB SSD; the engine default of 10 would refuse to start). It is not part of cfgHash. The Mac bundle keeps the 10 GB default. A value below 10 needs --allow-low-min-free.

rules._comment: precipConnectDbz / precipConnectIn: ours (proxy). Thick-cloud 4.1.8 lead-in 'connected by precipitation' has no 4010B number; Site Weather proxy review 2026-11-17 kept 15 dBZ / 0.01 in/h. Composite reflectivity only (virga / elevated echo can over-connect).
